summary.text: Vicki Quisenberry is the Democratic candidate for Kentucky State Senate District 8 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Gary Boswell.
A small business owner and former executive director of the Foundation for Daviess County Public Schools, she ran in a Democratic primary that was canceled.

paragraphs.text: Quisenberry attended Apollo High School and earned bachelor's (1983) and graduate (1990) degrees from Murray State University, according to Ballotpedia, which lists her profession as property management.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Quisenberry said she owns a small business that provides commercial space to entrepreneurs and corporations and has experience in the nonprofit sector.

She said she spent more than 13 years as executive director of the Foundation for Daviess County Public Schools and founded the Empowerment Academy, a 501(c)(3) that provides housing for at-risk high school students.
Quisenberry's stated campaign messages were fully funded public education, adequate health care for all Kentuckians, and economic development tied to education, health care and affordable housing.
She also said she supports Pre-K for all Kentucky four-year-olds.
